author.name: redcardinals

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A dashboard that charts how European Commission reports scored Serbia's reform progress from 2015 to 2023, sentence by sentence (each sentence coded from −1 to +1). You can split the scores by dimension, by effort type, by topic or by World-Systems interest group, view them as a yearly trend or a ranked bar chart, and export the chart and the data. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
